main.description: Returns the indexed evaluation at the given AT-URI with its publisher and evaluator views. Invalid evaluator entries are omitted from the hydrated projection while the original record is preserved. Authentication is not required.

uri.description: AT-URI of the evaluation record, using a DID authority; lookup is by URI only, not a specific CID/version.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI is invalid or does not identify an evaluation record.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: No indexed evaluation was found at this AT-URI.

hydratedEvaluationEvaluatorView.description: A valid original evaluator entry with its profile and organization sidecars looked up.

omittedEvaluationEvaluatorView.description: A valid original evaluator entry beyond the hydration position limit.

evaluationView.description: Evaluation with the original record, hydrated publisher, and evaluator projections. The record is not rewritten when evaluator data is malformed. A missing or non-array evaluator container yields an empty hydrated array; malformed entries are omitted. For hydrated actors, missing profile or organization sidecars are null; query or hydration failures fail the request. Evaluator arrays over 1000 entries still fail exact lookup and are skipped by lists.

evaluators.description: Dense projection of valid record.evaluators object entries with valid DIDs, preserving their source order and duplicates. Entries with malformed shapes or invalid DIDs are omitted without changing the original record; a missing or non-array source yields an empty array. Valid entries at source positions after 100 remain present with hydrationStatus "omitted" and no profile or organization. The raw evaluator array is limited to 1000 entries; over-limit records fail exact lookup and are skipped by lists.
